method: Read source, tests and local public docs; no live app clicks or Git mutations. Matching version labels do not prove exact installed source identity.
deployed_docs: https://paseo.sh/llms.txt was attempted through web and HTTP; unavailable (HTTP403 in direct fetch). Used pinned local source and local public-docs/worktrees.md instead.

findings.uncommitted: HEAD versus working content, including untracked files
findings.committed: Merge base of selected base ref with HEAD, compared to HEAD; excludes untracked files
findings.default: Uncommitted when dirty; Committed when clean, unless a current-state manual selection overrides it
findings.empty: Empty-message state, sometimes with a link to the other comparison mode; loading/non-Git/error are separate states
findings.branch_switch: Actual checkout; backend requires clean tree, UI offers stash-and-switch confirmation when dirty and optional restore on target branch
findings.commit: Separate operation; default addAll=true in request handler, stages all and commits; empty message may use agent-generated metadata
findings.uncommit: No dedicated uncommit/undo-commit/reset-soft command found in searched app and server source. Do not infer this operation from Committed/Uncommitted labels.
findings.live_updates: Filesystem and Git metadata observers,1-second debounce,5-second degraded polling fallback.

scope_questions: Owner clarification pending: view toggle versus actual commit/uncommit operations.
not_verified: Execution of branch switch, stash, commit or undo operations

agreed: Committed/Uncommitted are comparison views; no uncommit operation found.
Empty state is comparison-specific, not equivalent to a clean working tree.
Dirty defaults to Uncommitted; clean defaults to Committed. Manual choice expires on dirty-state boundary.
BranchSwitcher performs actual checkout and offers stash/restore; baseRef is obtained from status, not selected by this control.
Commit is a separate action, by default all changes; metadata generation is in the server.
Keep /files independent and read-only; adapt the Changes panel as /git.

current_interpretation: Treat owner commit/uncommit wording as Committed/Uncommitted view labels for this proposal; optional clarification is pending. Do not infer authorization to undo commits.
